title: Sonic 3's music hid a superstar
caption: Michael Jackson worked on Sonic 3's music without being credited. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #sonic3 #sega

instagram.caption:
Michael Jackson contributed music to Sonic the Hedgehog 3, but his name never appeared in the credits.

Fans suspected it for decades, hearing his style in tracks like Carnival Night and IceCap. In 2022, Sonic co-creator Yuji Naka confirmed his involvement.

When Sega released Sonic Origins that same year, several of those songs were swapped out. The originals live on in the old cartridges.

Can you hear him in Carnival Night?
